description:
🍨 No Added Sugar Salted Caramel Gelato (Ultra Creamy & Diabetic-Friendly Option)

This No Added Sugar Salted Caramel Gelato is silky, scoopable, and packed with deep caramel flavour — without traditional sugar.

Made with allulose and stevia, this gelato delivers sweetness and scoopability while keeping sugars extremely low. The result? A luxuriously smooth, clean-tasting caramel gelato with balanced salt and a soft, professional texture straight from the freezer.

If you’re reducing sugar but refuse to compromise on texture or flavour (even in a Ninja Creami....), this one’s for you.

⸻

📋 Full Recipe (750g Batch for Ninja Creami Deluxe)
 • Light Cream – 632.6g
 • Allulose – 80.1g
 • Skim Milk Powder – 32.3g
 • Salt – 3.0g
 • Stevia – 2.0g

Expect a soft dense gelato texture with beautiful spoon drag and creamy finish.

⸻

⏱️ Timestamps

00:00 Introduction
00:18 A bit about sugars
02:23 Making the base
04:01 Heating the Allulose
05:57 BUBBLES..!
07:38 Spining
08:00 Reveal, scoop an taste
08:27 Final Notes & Outro

⸻

🔬 What Makes This Recipe Special?

• No added sugar
• No sugar alcohol cooling effect
• Lower glycemic impact
• Excellent freeze-point control
• Professional gelato texture

Allulose gives body and scoopability, while stevia boosts sweetness without adding bulk sugars.

⸻
